decisions.reason: Pinpoints the disabled expression, busy as AttachButton-local and unreachable from AttachmentChips, empty occurrences returning null before the map, and plain phase falsifying the left guard so evaluating busy throws ReferenceError.

Explains the render-time throw is caught by the slot entry error boundary which unmounts the whole dock entry, AttachButton's separate slot entry survives, and the only trace is a console record with no user-facing banner.

Establishes busy pre-exists in shipped v0.2.10, explains the diff's stale base, proposes minimal data-present mount, v0.2.10 rollback, and re-add hunk bisect, discusses the misplaced imageItem (function-level record/status) and dropped aria-label as extra defects, and hedges field-history claims rather than asserting exact first exercise.

Removes the dangling busy keeping the phase guard (or properly scoped busy state/props), hardens with (record?.items ?? []) and event.target?.closest?.(), and scopes imageItem per-occurrence inside the map callback.

Proposes a plain-phase occurrence-present mount test asserting chip/remove DOM markers, zero boundary captures and clean console, explains the empty-state early return bypasses the line and that node --check is syntax-only so name resolution happens at evaluation, and includes the smoke as a pre-ship gate.
